name: kady-desktop
description: Electron desktop shell for K-Dense BYOK

scripts.dist: npm run build:icon && npm run build:runtime && npm run build:externals && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:web && npm run build:icon && npm run build:runtime && node scripts/verify-runtime-session.mjs && npm run build:externals && node scripts/verify-externals.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --mac -c.mac.identity=- -c.mac.entitlements=resources/entitlements.mac.adhoc.plist -c.mac.entitlementsInherit=resources/entitlements.mac.adhoc.plist -c.mac.timestamp=none --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:signed: npm run build:web && npm run build:icon && npm run build:runtime && node scripts/verify-runtime-session.mjs && npm run build:externals && node scripts/verify-externals.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --mac --publish never
